schema.text: Compared to the other ways you could realistically make your usual trip (e.g. walking, driving, public transport), how demanding is the way you usually travel?
schema.help: Demanding means how much physical or mental effort the trip takes.

options.text: Much less demanding than the alternatives
A little less demanding than the alternatives
About as demanding as the alternatives
A little more demanding than the alternatives
Much more demanding than the alternatives (physically or mentally)

en.#About as demanding as the alternatives: About as demanding as the alternatives

it.#Compared to the other ways you could re: Rispetto agli altri modi in cui potresti realisticamente fare il tuo spostamento abituale (ad es. a piedi, in auto, con i mezzi pubblici), quanto è impegnativo il modo in cui ti sposti di solito?
it.#Demanding means how much physical or me: Per impegnativo si intende quanta fatica fisica o mentale richiede lo spostamento.
it.#A little less demanding than the altern: Un po’ meno impegnativo delle alternative
it.#About as demanding as the alternatives: Impegnativo più o meno quanto le alternative
it.#A little more demanding than the altern: Un po’ più impegnativo delle alternative
it.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: Molto più impegnativo delle alternative (fisicamente o mentalmente)

fr.#Compared to the other ways you could re: Par rapport aux autres façons dont vous pourriez réalistement faire votre trajet habituel (par ex. à pied, en voiture, en transports en commun), à quel point votre façon habituelle de vous déplacer est-elle exigeante ?
fr.#Demanding means how much physical or me: Exigeant désigne l’effort physique ou mental que demande le trajet.
fr.#Much less demanding than the alternativ: Beaucoup moins exigeante que les alternatives
fr.#A little less demanding than the altern: Un peu moins exigeante que les alternatives
fr.#About as demanding as the alternatives: À peu près aussi exigeante que les alternatives
fr.#A little more demanding than the altern: Un peu plus exigeante que les alternatives
fr.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: Beaucoup plus exigeante que les alternatives (physiquement ou mentalement)

de.#Compared to the other ways you could re: Wie anstrengend ist die Art, wie Sie normalerweise unterwegs sind, im Vergleich zu den anderen realistischen Möglichkeiten für Ihren üblichen Weg (z. B. zu Fuß, mit dem Auto, mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln)?
de.#Demanding means how much physical or me: Anstrengend meint, wie viel körperliche oder geistige Mühe der Weg kostet.
de.#Much less demanding than the alternativ: Viel weniger anstrengend als die Alternativen
de.#A little less demanding than the altern: Etwas weniger anstrengend als die Alternativen
de.#About as demanding as the alternatives: Etwa so anstrengend wie die Alternativen
de.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: Viel anstrengender als die Alternativen (körperlich oder geistig)

tr.#Compared to the other ways you could re: Olağan yolculuğunuzu yapabileceğiniz diğer gerçekçi seçeneklerle (örneğin yürüyerek, otomobille, toplu taşımayla) karşılaştırıldığında, genellikle kullandığınız yol ne kadar yorucu?
tr.#Demanding means how much physical or me: Yorucu, yolculuğun ne kadar fiziksel veya zihinsel çaba gerektirdiği anlamına gelir.
tr.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: Alternatiflerden çok daha yorucu (fiziksel veya zihinsel olarak)

fa.#Compared to the other ways you could re: در مقایسه با راه‌های دیگری که به‌طور واقع‌بینانه می‌توانید سفر معمول خود را انجام دهید (مثلاً پیاده، با خودرو، با حمل‌ونقل عمومی)، روشی که معمولاً استفاده می‌کنید چقدر طاقت‌فرساست؟
fa.#Demanding means how much physical or me: منظور از دشوار بودن، میزان تلاش جسمی یا ذهنی است که سفر می‌طلبد.
fa.#Much less demanding than the alternativ: خیلی کمتر از گزینه‌های دیگر طاقت‌فرساست
fa.#A little less demanding than the altern: کمی کمتر از گزینه‌های دیگر طاقت‌فرساست
fa.#About as demanding as the alternatives: تقریباً به اندازه گزینه‌های دیگر طاقت‌فرساست
fa.#A little more demanding than the altern: کمی بیشتر از گزینه‌های دیگر طاقت‌فرساست
fa.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: خیلی بیشتر از گزینه‌های دیگر طاقت‌فرساست (از نظر جسمی یا ذهنی)

hu.#Compared to the other ways you could re: Ha összehasonlítja a szokásos útja megtételének más reális lehetőségeivel (például gyalog, autóval, tömegközlekedéssel), mennyire megterhelő az a mód, ahogyan általában közlekedik?
hu.#Demanding means how much physical or me: A megterhelő azt jelenti, mennyi fizikai vagy szellemi erőfeszítést kíván az út.
hu.#Much less demanding than the alternativ: Sokkal kevésbé megterhelő, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#A little less demanding than the altern: Valamivel kevésbé megterhelő, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#About as demanding as the alternatives: Nagyjából ugyanolyan megterhelő, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#A little more demanding than the altern: Valamivel megterhelőbb, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: Sokkal megterhelőbb, mint a többi lehetőség (fizikailag vagy szellemileg)

ar.#Compared to the other ways you could re: مقارنةً بالطرق الأخرى التي يمكنك بها واقعيًا القيام بتنقّلك المعتاد (مثل المشي أو القيادة أو النقل العام)، ما مدى إرهاق الطريقة التي تتنقل بها عادةً؟
ar.#Demanding means how much physical or me: يُقصد بالمُرهِق مقدار الجهد البدني أو الذهني الذي تتطلبه الرحلة.
ar.#Much more demanding than the alternativ: أكثر إرهاقًا بكثير من البدائل (جسديًا أو ذهنيًا)
